formulations_conditions_tested: Cho:DPPC LUVs 15:85, 30:70, 60:40 at 1:1 lipid:protein, pH 7.4, shaking (Matveyenka 2024); and 10-40% in a synaptic-mimic mix (Galvagnion 2016)
effect_direction_summary: DOSE-DEPENDENT and NOT protective: inert at <=30% cholesterol (t1/2 ~79 h vs 82 h control) but ACCELERATES at 60% (t1/2 61 h, lag 12.2 vs 16.4 h), attributed to increased membrane hydrophobicity. Did not initiate in the low-cholesterol synaptic mimic.
conflicting_findings: Overturns the intuition that cholesterol (membrane-ordering) would be protective - at high mol% it promotes aggregation.
quantitative_prediction_supported: Yes - explicit t1/2 and t_lag (Matveyenka 2024, Fig 3).
notes_for_assay: Effect depends strongly on mol% and on membrane fluidity; test a dose series, not a single %.

formulations_conditions_tested: 'Other sphingolipids' in Martinez 2007 (abstract); sphingomyelin not individually resolved. Grey tested sphingoSINE (not sphingomyelin).
effect_direction_summary: Martinez: 'other sphingolipids showed negligible interaction' (no effect). No dedicated SM ThT curve in the accessible pilot.
conflicting_findings: None, but evidence is thin and possibly conflates SM with other sphingolipids.
notes_for_assay: Under-characterised in accessible primary data. Distinguish sphingomyelin from sphingosine and from gangliosides. A dedicated ThT experiment is needed.

formulations_conditions_tested: DMPC:DMPS mixtures, ratio varied (Galvagnion 2016 SI Fig S2); pure-DMPC LUVs in Dou et al. (cited by Matveyenka 2024)
effect_direction_summary: Fluid (Tm 24C) neutral PC that binds enough to SEQUESTER: Dou et al. report pure DMPC LUVs STRONGLY SUPPRESS alpha-syn aggregation; and increasing DMPC fraction reduces DMPS-driven aggregation (>25% DMPC -> no stimulation). The most promising neutral candidate for suppression.
conflicting_findings: Contrasts sharply with DPPC (16:0): a 2-carbon-longer, gel-phase PC does NOT suppress.
quantitative_prediction_supported: Ordinal from Galvagnion; numeric suppression data is in the Dou et al. primary paper (to fetch).
notes_for_assay: Strong lead as a passive suppressor; get the Dou et al. paper for conditions/half-times.

formulations_conditions_tested: Pure DPPC LUVs + Cho:DPPC mixes, 1:1 lipid:protein, pH 7.4, 37C, shaking (Matveyenka 2024)
effect_direction_summary: Gel-phase (Tm 41C) neutral PC that does NOT suppress - pure DPPC SHORTENS the lag (12.3 vs 16.4 h), i.e. mildly promotes. Binds alpha-syn too weakly (gel) to sequester it.
conflicting_findings: Directly contrasts the DMPC suppression: '...not observed for DPPC... a change in two carbon atoms caused a major effect' (Matveyenka 2024).
notes_for_assay: Not a suppressor under these conditions; useful as a non-protective saturated-PC reference.

formulations_conditions_tested: Not tested in the pilot primary studies.
effect_direction_summary: No direct record in the accessible pilot.
notes_for_assay: No primary evidence yet; needs targeted search and/or a wet-lab experiment.

formulations_conditions_tested: Pure DOPC SUV (Gaspar 0.01-1 mM; Grey 0.2 mM); also matrix lipid in 9:1 mixes and synaptic-mimic
effect_direction_summary: No detectable triggering of aggregation when pure; mild retardation in Grey. In lipid_induced assays this is 'no effect', NOT demonstrated inhibition (control also flat).
conflicting_findings: None across Grey/Gaspar/Galvagnion - consistently inert/retarding as a pure lipid.
quantitative_prediction_supported: Qualitative only (no-effect/retardation); no comparable half-time extracted.
notes_for_assay: Good negative/inert reference. Note it is the standard zwitterionic matrix; effects attributed to additives, not DOPC.

formulations_conditions_tested: Not tested in the pilot primary studies (POPS, not POPC, was tested).
effect_direction_summary: No direct record; note POPS (phosphatidylserine) was tested by Galvagnion and showed no triggering, but that is a different headgroup from POPC.
notes_for_assay: No primary evidence yet; do not transfer POPS result to POPC (different headgroup/charge).

formulations_conditions_tested: 9:1 DOPC:GM1 SUV (Grey 0.1-0.5 mM, quiescent & shaking; Gaspar 0.1-0.5 mM); GM1-SUV (Martinez)
effect_direction_summary: CONDITION-DEPENDENT. Accelerates at mildly acidic pH 5.5 (Grey, Gaspar), concentration-dependent. Inhibits/eliminates fibrillation at neutral pH (Martinez 2007; corroborated by Grey ref57/Gaspar ref67).
conflicting_findings: Direct direction conflict driven by pH (accelerate at 5.5 vs inhibit at ~7.4). Also formulation differs (pure GM1-SUV vs 10% GM1 in DOPC).
quantitative_prediction_supported: Not yet - acceleration curves need digitization; inhibition is abstract-only (no numbers).
notes_for_assay: Highest-priority candidate but direction depends on pH/formulation. Yuval's pH is decisive.
